primary.title: Reliance Industries promoters raise stake during Q1FY26. Check details
primary.summary: Promoters of Reliance Industries increased their stake to 50.5% by June, the highest in over three years. Mutual funds also raised their holding to 10.11%. Analysts anticipate strong financial results driven by oil and telecom sectors despite retail challenges.
